widgets_values:
A complete **Krea 2 Film Studio** generation node built inside ComfyUI, designed to keep the entire image workflow inside one clean interface. It supports **Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, Directed Control, custom resolutions, megapixel scaling, sampler settings, seeds, LoRA loading, prompt history, gallery, autosave, and model settings**, while still outputting a standard ComfyUI **IMAGE, LATENT, and used seed** for use with other nodes.

The goal is to make Krea 2 feel like a standalone creative studio while keeping everything fully local and integrated with ComfyUI.

1MP For 720
2MP For 1080

widgets_values:
Guide: [Subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph)

## Model Links

For BF16 and NVFP4 variants, see [Comfy-Org/Krea-2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2)

**diffusion_models**

- [krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

**vae**

- [Wan_2.1_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/blob/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors)

**loras**

- [krea2_CanonUltraReal](https://civitai.red/models/2783143/canon-ultrareal)

- [krea2_CinematicMovieStill](https://civitai.red/models/2840790/cinematic-movie-still)

**CustomNodes (CONTROLNET)**

- [KREACONTROLNET_NODE](https://github.com/facok/comfyui-krea2-controlnet)

**Depth Lora (REQUIRED)**

- [KREACONTROLNET_LORA](https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/tree/main)



## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
│   └── 📂 loras/
│       └── Placeholder.safetensors
```
